english.note: For an ongoing activity, 一路 is the all-purpose choice meaning that someone keeps doing it continuously.

examples.english: I kept running away without stopping.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 paau2 mou5 ting4 gwo3

boxes.meaning: doing one thing while doing another

english.note: Use this when the action continues throughout a particular stretch of time or activity.
Use this for an action continuing throughout a particular period or alongside another action.

boxes.note: Say it twice, once before each of the two actions.

examples.english: We chatted ceaselessly all the way to the waterfront.
examples.traditional: 我哋一路傾偈一路行到海旁。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 lou6 king1 gai2 jat1 lou6 haang4 dou3 hoi2 pong4

examples.english: I continually eat crisps while watching TV.
examples.traditional: 我一路睇電視一路食薯片。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 tai2 din6 si6 jat1 lou6 sik6 syu4 pin2
